Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct anomaly characterized by a sudden, sharp jump in the value of E (mm) from approximately -5.0 to +4.0. This occurs around the x-axis coordinate of 600 and persists until the end of the data.

The range of this anomaly starts right after the vertical jump at roughly x=600 and continues to the last point shown on the graph, which is slightly past x=700 (around 730).

Therefore, the detected range of anomalies is:
[[601, 730]]
